⬆️ Bulk Import Products

Upload an Excel (.xlsx / .xls) or CSV file. Columns: id, name, category, subcategory, price, stock, specs, downloadLink (downloadLink is optional, for Windows / Antivirus). Leave id blank to add a new product. If id matches an existing product, that product will be updated (overwritten) instead of duplicated. If category/subcategory don't exist yet, they'll be created automatically.

For PC Builder compatibility, write the specs like this (Label: value | Label: value): CPU → Socket, TDP, Integrated Graphics; Motherboard → Socket, Form Factor, Memory Type, M.2 Slots; RAM → Memory Type; Cabinet → MB Support, Cabinet Size; Cooler → Radiator Size, Socket Support; SMPS → Wattage.
